pieces.name: DB03_Crate_PlankShort
pieces.note: Short whole wall plank 0.40 x 0.196 x 0.025 m (PR17 plank section), bowed ~1 cm and twisted 7 deg; one chipped corner, short split at the far end; planksV strip at PR17 texel density, endgrain saw cuts.

pieces.name: DB03_Crate_PlankSplintered
pieces.note: Broken wall plank ~0.53 m: clean saw-cut end, the other end torn into 5 long pointy splinters (real geometry, splinter tips thinned to 4-7 mm and curled up/down from top/bottom layers).

pieces.name: DB03_Crate_PlankNail
pieces.note: Wall plank piece ~0.36 m, short broken end; a scrap of the iron band (55 mm, darkpatch) still on it, torn end bent up; a half-pulled rusty nail (3-sided bent prism + head, darkpatch) sticking up near the break.

pieces.name: DB03_Crate_Corner
pieces.note: Corner post piece 0.30 m, 68 mm square (PR17 post, plankH grain along the post), saw-cut bottom, jagged broken top with a tall splinter; two 84x23 mm batten stubs nailed on at 90 deg (one pried out 7 deg), both with jagged broken ends.
